mcqs.question: The F1 Sim Racing India Open 2026 was notable for which distinction?
options: India’s first official Formula 1 Sim Racing Championship and first F1-approved national sim racing competition
India’s first Formula 1 Grand Prix, held at Buddh International Circuit from 2011 to 2013
The first Formula 1 championship, established in 1950 and governed by the FIA
The first transfer of sim racing governance from Formula 1 to the FIA
mcqs.explanation: The F1 Sim Racing India Open 2026 was India’s first official Formula 1 Sim Racing Championship and the first F1-approved national sim racing competition. The Buddh International Circuit hosted the Indian Grand Prix from 2011 to 2013, but that was a Formula 1 race rather than this sim racing championship.
